title: Add Plant State and Advisor integration, provider failure, and safety regression suite

gates.name: FT-011 regression suite
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/runtime_state backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/safety backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/runtime_state backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/safety backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security -k 'eval or provider_failure or safety or missing or stale or conflict'

verify: Regression suite covers no-promotion, missing pH/EC, stale pH/EC, conflicting evidence, ActorContext/PlantAccessGrant scoping, Consultant denial, Safety Gate route/block, governance substitution denial, provider failure, and first-demo UI/API visibility.
Harness evals include prompt injection, model suggests immediate action, provider failure, no fake advisor success, and missing/stale/conflict behavior.
Evidence is sufficient for /verify and /red-verify to assess semantic correctness.
Run the frontend/UI smoke or e2e gate once the frontend test runner exists; until then, record API/UI handoff evidence and the missing-runner reason in /verify.
evidence_required: full FT-011 regression and eval output
coverage notes for all FT-011 acceptance criteria
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
UI/e2e evidence when a frontend test runner exists; if no frontend runner exists yet, /verify must record the no-run reason and API/UI handoff evidence under the task report.
constraints: Tests must prove cautious behavior under missing/stale/conflicting data and provider failure.
Safety routing tests must not implement FT-012/FT-013 approval/task semantics in FT-011.
Runtime/demo advisor acceptance cannot rely on fake, mock, hardcoded, or stubbed output.
invariants: No confirmed Plant state from agent-only evidence.
No immediate physical-action wording before Safety Gate clearance and authorized approval.
No automated actuation command exists in MVP.
verification_targets: UI/e2e smoke evidence or explicit no-runner handoff note
